system.name: OSWorld
system.one_liner: A scalable real computer environment and a 369-task benchmark for multimodal agents, with task setup, execution-based evaluation and interactive learning.

content.variant_note: one agent exchanging observations and actions with a blue virtual-machine region, with set-up and evaluation arrows; two screenshot rows with dashed cursor trails above show real task runs
content.argues: OSWorld offers one real, scalable computer environment where agents set up tasks, act with mouse and keyboard across arbitrary apps and operating systems, and are scored by execution-based evaluation.
content.subject: two real desktop tasks as screenshot rows, and below the agent, task config, virtual machine, observation and action arrows, final state and evaluation

lessons.what_to_learn: Open with real screen captures of two tasks joined by dashed cursor trails so the reader sees what an agent does, then draw the environment as one blue region holding the logos of the systems, apps and interfaces it covers, with parallel observation and action arrows to a single agent box.
lessons.suits: benchmarks and environments for GUI or tool-using agents where breadth of applications and real task traces are the selling point.

evidence: This executable environment allows free-form raw keyboard and mouse control of real computer applications
supports initial task state configuration, execution-based evaluation, and interactive learning across mainstream operating systems
first-of-its-kind scalable, real computer environment for multimodal agents

summary: OSWorld is a scalable real computer environment and a benchmark of 369 tasks for multimodal agents. The figure stacks two rows of real screenshots, one per example task, with a sentence above each and a dashed cursor trail through the frames: a bookkeeping spreadsheet update with a receipt photo, and a snake-game code fix in VS Code. Below, the architecture shows a task instruction and a set-up config at the left, an Agent box (e.g., GPT-4V) in the middle exchanging observations (screenshot, a11y-tree) and actions (mouse, keyboard) with a blue environment region of virtual machines holding OS, app and interface logos, and a final state feeding execution-based evaluation.
summary_zh: OSWorld 是面向多模态智能体的真实计算机环境与 369 题基准。图上方两行真实截图配任务句子和虚线鼠标轨迹（记账表格、贪吃蛇代码修复）；下方架构图画出任务指令、初始状态配置、智能体与虚拟机环境之间的观察与动作，以及基于执行的评测。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The digest counts 58 placed bitmaps because each screenshot is stored as two layers (image plus shadow or mask); six screenshots are visible. The meaning of the unlabelled up arrow from Task Instruction to the set-up config is inferred.
